programmes.d: A chef bets she can turn around the worst restaurant in the city but ends up falling for the owner.
A cop-turned-writer creates suspicion when she publishes her first novel.
Ghostwriter Becca unexpectedly ends up on the trail from a legendary novel with action star Lee.
Landscape architect Evie meets her match with new client Ryan, whose daughters are her biggest fan.
A woman faces opposition from her estranged father when she plans to sell the family's dance studio.

Fitness instructor Julia is down on her luck trying to make her baby boot camp a thriving business. To make ends meet she becomes a part-time nanny for a widower father--although she knows nothing about taking care of children.

A wealthy and successful career woman gets a second chance in life when a magical wish transports her back in time eight years to when she walked away from her fiance to lead a business life in New York.

A young woman is determined to get home for Christmas, but gets stranded in a small town during a snow storm. Little does she know that she is exactly where she is supposed to be.
A loving aunt struggles to adopt her young relatives after their parents die in a car accident.
Impresario aids fiancée in search for her fallen climber, masking his true goal: finding a spy satellite.
Tori teams up with Million Dollar Matchmaker Patti Stanger to host a series of dates for Morgan, one of her single friends.
